_comment: Golden refusal bodies for the silent-listen routes (supervisor-silent-listen, design D7). Body convention (Platform ErrorResponse, read by Web's ApiError): `error` carries ONLY a kebab-case machine code, never prose and never a separate `code` field; the other members are typed fields of one sealed record whose first property is Error (precedent: ConversationStartRefusal, PartnerChannelRefusals), registered in ApiJsonContext. conversationId and listenId are string|null and ALWAYS written; trunkId (integer|null, change outbound-calls-reach-the-trunk) is ALWAYS written too, an integer only on trunk-not-dialable, never omitted: conversationId is the route's conversation id (null on current and endpoint, which have none), except already-listening, where it and listenId name the caller's EXISTING listen. Routes: start = POST /api/v1/supervisor/conversations/{id}/listen; stop = POST /api/v1/supervisor/conversations/{id}/listen/stop; current = GET /api/v1/supervisor/listen; endpoint = POST /api/v1/supervisor/listen-endpoint. A caller without the SupervisorPlus role gets the group's bare 403 before any of these. Precedence on start, first match wins: not-permitted, invalid-destination, voice-unavailable, not-leader, conversation-not-found, no-voice-call, already-listening, no-supervisor-endpoint | no-listen-phone, no-trunk, trunk-not-dialable, originate-failed. Each entry gives its HTTP status and the routes that can answer it. not-leader is 503 and retryable: this replica does not hold the voice AMI lease (API runs 1 replica; the only pod normally holds it). voice-unavailable is 503: telephony (AMI) is not configured on this host. originate-failed is 502: Asterisk refused or did not acknowledge the originate; nothing was left behind. Every child change's delta spec must cite these codes and field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

noSupervisorEndpoint._note: on endpoint: the tenant id makes {tenantId}-{extension} exceed the 40-character SIP auth username, so no credentials are returned; conversationId is null there

listenNotFound._note: stop echoes its route's conversationId; current answers conversationId null, as shown
